reason: The hypothesis proposes adding yttrium to form in-situ oxide dispersoids in a specific WTaCrV alloy to suppress radiation-induced precipitation, an intervention not tested or suggested in any passage. It combines the known precipitation problem of the quaternary alloy (P1, P2, P4) with the oxide-dispersion strategy mentioned generically in P16, but applies it to a new material system and fabrication route (powder processing) not studied in the literature, with a mechanism linking oxide sinks to solute trapping and sinterability.
